title: Forcing or structure? Hourly streamflow modeling in two data-scarce Andean páramo catchments – processing and modeling pipeline
description: Python and R pipeline (stages 00–14) that builds nine precipitation forcings (rain gauges and raw and machine-learning-corrected IMERG, GSMaP, ERA5-Land and their fusion), runs four model structures (GR4H, LSTM, LightGBM and a GR4H error model) in two nested páramo catchments of the Ecuadorian Andes (Tambo and Chalpi Grande), and partitions out-of-sample hourly KGE′ differences between forcing and structure with a two-way ANOVA, block bootstrap and a reversed split-sample test. Includes the configuration, the result tables and figures of the article and the supplementary material. Station records of EPMAPS/FONAG are not redistributed; see DATA.md.
